crevasse: Ross warned everyone not to fall into a deep crevasse, then nearly fell in himself.
crikey: Joey said crikey every time he opened a bill, because he was always surprised by it.
crouton: Monica placed one tiny crouton on top of the salad and called it fine dining.
crucial: It was crucial that nobody told Monica about the crumbs on her counter.
crude: Chandler made a crude joke at dinner, and Monica threw a napkin right at him.
crumbling: Ross watched his crumbling fossil model fall apart and looked genuinely heartbroken.
crustacean: Phoebe said she once freed a crustacean back into the sea and sang it a goodbye song.
cubic: Ross calculated the cubic meters of the museum's new exhibit, just to show off.
culler: Chandler invented a job called culler of bad jokes and gave himself the title.
cultivate: Phoebe tried to cultivate a tiny herb garden on her windowsill and forgot to water it.
cumulative: The cumulative effect of eating Monica's cooking was a very tight pair of pants.
cunning: Joey thought he was cunning for hiding snacks, but Monica found them in ten seconds.
cure: Monica insisted her chicken soup could cure any cold in the entire city.
cyberstalking: Chandler accused Joey of cyberstalking a celebrity, but Joey just liked all her posts.
cynical: Chandler was cynical about love until he actually fell for Monica and softened up.
dagnabbit: Joey yelled dagnabbit when he dropped his sandwich onto Monica's kitchen floor.
dam: Ross explained how a dam works, then built a tiny one out of couch cushions.
dandelion: Phoebe blew on a dandelion and said she was making a wish for a better world.
dank: Chandler described the basement of the building as dank and refused to go down there.
daring: Rachel said wearing that bold dress to Ralph Lauren was a daring fashion choice.
daunting: Monica found cooking for twelve people daunting, but she wrote out a twenty-step plan.
deactivate: Chandler threatened to deactivate Joey's alarm clock after he slept through three auditions.
debris: Monica swept up the debris from Joey's sandwich explosion and sighed deeply.
deceased: Phoebe said her goldfish was deceased, then held a tiny funeral with a song.
decline: Ross politely declined a fourth slice of cake, then took it anyway a moment later.
dedication: Monica's dedication to cleaning was so intense that she dusted the ceiling twice.
defeat: Chandler admitted defeat in the board game and flipped the whole table over in protest.
defenseless: Joey said he felt defenseless without his lucky sweater for a soap opera callback.
defer: Rachel decided to defer her shopping trip so she could help Monica with dinner.
defiance: In an act of pure defiance, Joey ate the leftover pie right in front of Monica.
deficiency: Ross claimed he had a deficiency of sleep, then stayed up reading about dinosaurs.
deflate: The bounce house started to deflate slowly while Joey was still jumping inside.
defy: Monica dared anyone to defy her cleaning rules, and everyone quietly obeyed instead.
degrade: Chandler said that terrible movie would degrade anyone's taste in film.
degraded: The degraded couch at Central Perk sagged a little lower every single week.
dehydration: Monica warned Joey about dehydration after he drank nothing but coffee for three days.
deject: Joey tried not to deject Rachel by admitting he'd forgotten their lunch plans.
dejectedly: Ross walked dejectedly away after Monica beat him at chess for the fifth time.
delegation: Monica formed a delegation to ask Ross to stop talking about fossils at dinner.
delinquent: Chandler joked that the delinquent squirrel should be arrested for stealing his bagel.
dementia: Phoebe said her grandma had dementia but still remembered every lyric to Smelly Cat.
demise: Chandler blamed the party's demise on Joey eating all the snacks in ten minutes.
democracy: Monica's kitchen was no democracy, and she made that perfectly clear to everyone.
demote: Joey threatened to demote Chandler from best friend after one really bad joke.
denominator: Ross tried to explain the denominator of a fraction, and Joey's eyes glazed over.
departure: Rachel's departure from Central Perk was slowed by five goodbyes and a big hug.
deplete: Joey managed to deplete the entire fridge in a single weekend of snacking.
deplore: Monica said she deplored the state of her kitchen after Joey tried to cook.
depository: Chandler called his sock drawer a depository for things he never needed.
deprecate: Ross would deprecate his own cooking before anyone else could even taste it.
deprivation: Phoebe said sleep deprivation made her sing even stranger songs than usual.
deputy: Monica appointed herself deputy of the household and enforced rules on everyone.
derail: Chandler's dumb joke managed to derail the entire serious conversation at dinner.
deranged: Joey called the weird neighbor deranged, then realized he was talking about himself.
derive: Ross could derive a whole lecture from a single small fossil in his hand.
designate: Monica decided to designate one drawer for Joey's snacks to keep things organized.
desired: Rachel finally got her desired job at a fashion house and celebrated with a huge coffee.
despicable: Chandler called it despicable that Joey ate the last slice and left the empty box.
despise: Monica said she'd despise anyone who set a cup down without a coaster.
destruct: Joey promised not to destruct the apartment, then broke a lamp within an hour.
detain: Chandler tried to detain Joey at Central Perk so he wouldn't be late again.
detection: The smoke detection went off because Ross burned the toast for the third time.
detox: Phoebe said she needed a sugar detox, then ordered a giant slice of cheesecake.
devise: Monica tried to devise a plan to keep Joey away from her cookie jar forever.
dew: Phoebe sat on the grass admiring the morning dew, then got her jeans soaked.
diagnosis: Ross gave a ridiculous diagnosis for Joey's fake illness, complete with a chart.
dibble: Joey admitted he had no idea what dibble meant, and honestly neither did anyone else.
diesel: Chandler said the old truck smelled like diesel and bad decisions.
differentiate: Ross could differentiate every kind of dinosaur but not two identical coffee cups.
diligence: Monica's diligence in cleaning meant not a single speck of dust survived her visit.
dimwit: Rachel lovingly called Joey a dimwit after he mixed up everyone's coffee orders.
dioxide: Ross explained carbon dioxide, then Joey asked if that was the same as soda pop.
directorate: Chandler claimed to run a secret directorate of snack decisions in the apartment.
disastrous: Monica's attempt at a romantic dinner turned disastrous when the smoke alarm went off.
disband: Chandler said the group should disband after a fight over the last cookie.
discourse: Ross wanted a calm discourse about dinosaurs, but everyone just wanted pizza.
discrepancy: There was a discrepancy between the food Monica bought and what was left by evening.
discrete: Ross explained a discrete object is separate, and Joey said it sounded like a typo.
disembowel: Joey said the horror movie was so gross it seemed to disembowel the main character.
disgraced: Chandler joked he'd be disgraced if anyone saw him singing along to Smelly Cat.
disinfect: Monica made everyone disinfect their hands before touching her clean kitchen.
dispenser: Chandler broke the tape dispenser and quietly put it back on the desk.
disposition: Phoebe said Joey had a sunny disposition, which is why everyone forgave his mess.
dispute: Monica and Joey got into a dispute over who ate the last brownie.
disqualify: Ross worried a spilled coffee would disqualify him from the museum's special tour.
disrobe: Joey had to disrobe for a doctor scene and quickly learned how awkward acting could be.
distinguish: Rachel couldn't distinguish between the two identical scarves, so she bought both.
distinguished: Gunther tried to look distinguished behind the counter, and mostly just stared at Rachel.
distress: Monica was in visible distress when she found a crumb on her freshly mopped floor.
district: Rachel loved shopping in the fashion district more than anywhere else in the city.
diversity: Phoebe said diversity is beautiful, then introduced her weird but wonderful friends.
dizzy: Joey spun around one too many times and got so dizzy he fell onto the couch.
doable: Monica declared cooking Thanksgiving dinner totally doable, then wrote a hundred-item list.
dockland: Ross said he once got lost in the dockland and missed his whole museum tour.
doctored: Chandler claimed the photo was doctored, but his hair really did look that bad.
dodgy: Joey bought a dodgy sandwich from a street cart and immediately regretted everything.
doggone: Chandler said doggone it when he dropped his coffee all over his clean shirt.
domestic: Monica was proud of her domestic skills, and even prouder of being bossy about them.
donkey: Joey insisted a donkey is just a small horse and refused to be corrected by Ross.
doomsday: Chandler planned for doomsday by buying extra coffee and nothing else useful.
doozy: Monica called the mountain of dirty dishes from Thanksgiving a real doozy.
downbeat: The movie was so downbeat that Phoebe had to sing Smelly Cat to cheer everyone up.
downward: Joey's acting career trended downward until he finally landed a part in a small play.
doze: Chandler liked to doze on the couch while Rachel and Monica talked about their day.
dramatically: Ross dramatically fell to his knees when Rachel agreed to go out with him again.
dredge: Monica had to dredge the sink after Joey poured pasta down the drain again.
drizzle: There was a light drizzle outside, so everyone stayed at Central Perk for one more cup.
dub: Joey tried to dub over a foreign film with his own voice and made it hilarious.
dullness: Chandler blamed the party's dullness on Joey's terrible jokes and stale chips.
dune: Phoebe sat on a sand dune and imagined she was in a magical faraway land.
durable: Monica bought a durable pan because she insisted her kitchen would outlast everyone.
durian: Joey tried a durian and said it smelled like a gym sock, but he ate it anyway.
duvet: Rachel wrapped herself in a duvet and refused to get out of bed all morning.
dynamite: Chandler said Monica's lasagna was dynamite, then asked for a second helping.
earnest: Joey gave an earnest speech about his acting dream, and even Chandler stopped joking.
eccentric: Phoebe was the most eccentric person at Central Perk, and everyone loved her for it.
echo: Ross shouted into a cave on a museum trip and loved the echo so much he did it twenty times.
eclectic: Monica's decorating taste was eclectic, mixing dusty antiques with gleaming new things.
educator: Ross loved being an educator, mostly because he got to talk about dinosaurs all day.
egging: Joey kept egging Chandler on until Chandler finally did something embarrassing.
egomaniac: Chandler called Ross an egomaniac for talking about himself for a whole hour.
elevate: Monica tried to elevate the party food with tiny umbrellas and fancy little sticks.
elevation: Ross explained elevation changes in the mountains while Joey stared at the clouds.
elite: Chandler joked that Central Perk was an elite club serving very average coffee.
elitism: Phoebe said elitism was silly because everyone puts their pants on the same way.
elope: Ross once worried Rachel would elope to Las Vegas without telling him first.
embody: Phoebe said her guitar seemed to embody the spirit of every unhappy cat in the world.
emphasized: Monica emphasized that nobody should touch her good plates before the guests arrived.
empirical: Ross insisted on empirical evidence for everything, except his own love life.
enclosure: Joey built a tiny enclosure for a bug he found and named it after himself.
endure: Chandler said he could endure anything except Monica's spicy chili on an empty stomach.
enforce: Monica loved to enforce the rules of the apartment, especially the no-shoes one.
enforcement: The enforcement of Monica's cleaning schedule was stricter than any real job.
engorged: Ross explained that a tick becomes engorged with blood, and Joey left the room.
entomb: Chandler joked that his leftovers were entombed in the back of Monica's fridge.
entrust: Monica would never entrust Joey with her good china, not even for a second.
enviously: Chandler watched Joey eat a huge sandwich enviously while his own salad got soggy.
envoy: Ross claimed he was an envoy from the museum, then admitted he was just an employee.
eon: Chandler said it felt like an eon waiting for Monica to finish cleaning before dinner.
epidermal: Ross explained the epidermal layer of skin, and Phoebe asked if that was the fancy word for skin.
erectile: Chandler made a terrible joke about an erectile issue and got a pillow thrown at him.
escort: Joey offered to escort Rachel to her fashion event and wore his nicest shirt.
etcetera: Monica listed chores, cleaning, cooking, etcetera, and Joey groaned the whole time.
eternal: Phoebe believed in eternal love and sang a haunting song about it at the coffee shop.
ethic: Chandler claimed his work ethic was strong, then took a three-hour lunch break.
evacuation: There was a fire drill evacuation at the museum, and Ross tried to save every fossil.
evade: Joey tried to evade Monica's questions about the missing cake, but he cracked fast.
evaporation: Monica explained evaporation, but really she just wanted to complain about a puddle.
evasive: Chandler was evasive about where he'd been, so everyone suspected a secret date.
evoke: Phoebe's song could evoke tears from even the toughest guy in the coffee shop.
